const e=[`claude`,`codebuddy`,`qoder`,`codex`,`hermes`,`pi`,`omp`,`prime-agent`,`cursor`,`gemini`,`antigravity`,`rovo`,`copilot`,`opencode`,`opencode2`,`zcode`,`grok`,`openclaw`,`devin`,`droid`,`cline`,`kimi`,`muse`,`jcode`],t=64;function n(e){return e instanceof Error&&(e.name===`AbortError`||e.message.includes(`Agent Session History scan was cancelled`))}const r=[`relevance`,`newest`],i={claude:`Claude`,codebuddy:`CodeBuddy`,qoder:`Qoder`,codex:`Codex`,hermes:`Hermes`,pi:`Pi`,omp:`OMP`,"prime-agent":`Prime Agent`,cursor:`Cursor`,gemini:`Gemini`,antigravity:`Antigravity`,rovo:`Rovo Dev`,copilot:`GitHub Copilot`,opencode:`OpenCode`,opencode2:`OpenCode 2`,zcode:`ZCode`,grok:`Grok`,openclaw:`OpenClaw`,devin:`Devin`,droid:`Droid`,cline:`Cline`,kimi:`Kimi`,muse:`Muse`,jcode:`Jcode`};function a(e){return e.messageCount>0||e.previewMessages.some(e=>e.role===`user`||e.role===`assistant`)}function o(e){return Math.max(0,e.queuedMessageCount)+Math.max(0,e.subagentTranscriptCount)}function s(e){return!a(e)&&o(e)>0}function c(e){return i[e]}export{c as a,s as c,r as i,a as l,i as n,o,t as r,n as s,e as t};
